externalDocs.description: Spring Boot Actuator Web API Documentation

post.description: AI agent drafts a mock Request for Quotation. This endpoint NEVER sends anything externally - it creates an in-memory/DB mock only, for the Human-in-the-Loop approval gate.
Formula: annualSpendInr * costFraction * deltaPercentagePoints / 100. Returns BigDecimal - AI must NOT recompute this.
Returns daysOfCover = unitsOnHand / dailyDemand. Returns UNKNOWN if dailyDemand is 0 or null.
AI agent classifies the risk signal text into a category. AI must cite evidenceIds from the response - never invent.

Returns duty exposure (INR), days of cover, stockout date, Monte Carlo percentiles (p10/p50/p90), and ranked recovery options. All arithmetic runs in deterministic Java - AI agents do NOT compute numbers.

post.summary: Import supply chain network via multipart CSV upload
post.description: Atomically parses and validates supplier nodes and links from CSV. Supports mode=replace (default) or mode=append.
Wipes all data and loads the deterministic Hydraulic Pump Housing demo. Use seed=20261121 for the official Hackfest demo. Gated by deeptier.demo.reset-enabled.

post.summary: Push Purchase Requisition to SAP S/4HANA
post.description: Executes live OData V2 CSRF+POST when S4HANA_BASE_URL is configured, or simulated S/4HANA push otherwise. Marks RFQ as PUSHED_TO_SAP and logs SAP_PR_PUSHED.
Validates shipment request via typed Java DTOs and proxies to TradePilot's 57-hub India road/multimodal graph on Python :8000 with an 8s bounded timeout.
